title: Contract & payment
subtitle: Your contract, its instalments and the details we need for applications and the embassy.

installments.title: Instalments
installments.subtitle: Each instalment has a fixed date or falls due after a step of your case.
installments.free: This contract is free for you and has no instalments. The university pays for the services.
installments.empty: The contract's instalments show here once the finance team adds them.

profile.title: Your details
profile.subtitle: Needed for university and embassy forms. Every change is recorded in your case.

error.email: Enter a valid email, like name@example.com.
error.mobile: Enter a mobile number starting with 09, 11 digits.
error.phone: Enter the number with its area code, like 03132000000.
error.server: Not saved. Check the value and try again.

help.title: A question about your contract or an instalment?
help.withConsultant: Your consultant, {{name}}, follows up instalments. Ask in a ticket.
help.text: Ask in a ticket; our team will answer.

payment.title: Payment details
payment.invalid: This payment wasn't found. The link may be old.
payment.toReceipt: Pay by card transfer and upload the receipt
payment.gateway: Paid through a secure bank gateway
payment.onlineError: Couldn't reach the payment gateway. Try again in a moment.

declined.title: Your receipt wasn't accepted
declined.text: Upload the correct receipt again, or pay online.

receipt.title: Pay with a receipt
receipt.subtitle: Transfer the amount to the account below and upload the receipt.
receipt.hint: PDF or a clear photo (JPG or PNG), up to {{size}}.

receipt.error: The receipt wasn't uploaded. Check your internet connection and try again.

review.title: We received your receipt
review.text: The sales team will check it and let you know by SMS.

start.title: Starting your case
start.subtitle: Your contract is approved. Once the prepayment is in, a supervisor is assigned and your panel opens.
start.unpaid: To start your case, pay the contract prepayment ({{amount}}) online or send a transfer receipt.
start.declined: The prepayment receipt ({{amount}}) wasn't accepted. See why on the payment page and send it again.
start.review: We got your prepayment receipt ({{amount}}) and are checking it. Once it's confirmed, your case goes to a supervisor.
start.paid: Your prepayment ({{amount}}) is paid. A supervisor will be assigned to your case soon and will call you.
